rusty_sword.name: Rusty Sword
rusty_sword.description: Dull iron that still remembers how to kill.

wooden_shield.name: Wooden Shield
wooden_shield.description: Oak and iron. It'll hold. Probably.

cloth_armor.name: Cloth Armor
cloth_armor.description: Layered linen. Stops a scratch, not a blade.

leather_boots.name: Leather Boots
leather_boots.description: Soft soles for quiet steps. The dungeon listens.

herb_pouch.name: Herb Pouch
herb_pouch.description: Dried moonvine. Smells like fate bending.

torn_cape.name: Torn Cape
torn_cape.description: Catches the wind more than the blade.

steel_buckler.name: Steel Buckler
steel_buckler.description: Compact steel. Turns blades, costs speed.

chainmail.name: Chainmail
chainmail.description: Rings of steel. Every step announces you.

swift_boots.name: Swift Boots
swift_boots.description: Wind-threaded. You move like smoke now.

venom_dagger.name: Venom Dagger
venom_dagger.description: Basilisk-coated. The wound is just the beginning.

battle_hammer.name: Battle Hammer
battle_hammer.description: Swings slow. Hits like the floor caving in.

wolf_pelt.name: Wolf Pelt
wolf_pelt.description: Dire wolf hide. Warm, tough, and restless.

lucky_coin.name: Lucky Coin
lucky_coin.description: Stamped with a dead god's face. Still works.

flamebrand.name: Flamebrand
flamebrand.description: The flame never dies. Neither do the burns.

guardian_plate.name: Guardian Plate
guardian_plate.description: Warden-forged steel. Built to outlast the dungeon.

shadow_cloak.name: Shadow Cloak
shadow_cloak.description: Woven from condensed darkness. You blur at the edges.

arcane_staff.name: Arcane Staff
arcane_staff.description: Raw mana in crystal form. Volatile. Beautiful.

berserker_axe.name: Berserker Axe
berserker_axe.description: All offense. No apologies. No guard.

vampiric_blade.name: Vampiric Blade
vampiric_blade.description: The blade drinks. So do you.

thieves_gloves.name: Thieves' Gloves
thieves_gloves.description: Guild-issue silk. Every movement becomes intent.

dragonbone_greatsword.name: Dragonbone Greatsword
dragonbone_greatsword.description: Carved from a dragon's spine. Swings like judgment.

aegis_of_light.name: Aegis of Light
aegis_of_light.description: Holy radiance made steel. You endure.

stormcaller.name: Stormcaller
stormcaller.description: Living lightning in your hands. It obeys. Mostly.

blood_gauntlets.name: Blood Gauntlets
blood_gauntlets.description: Every blow you deal feeds you back.

void_edge.name: Void Edge
void_edge.description: Cuts reality. Wounds refuse to close.

titans_bulwark.name: Titan's Bulwark
titans_bulwark.description: Giant-forged. Immovable. You're not running anywhere.

phoenix_feather.name: Phoenix Feather
phoenix_feather.description: Still burning. Still alive. Like you.

blackened_sword.name: The Blackened Sword
blackened_sword.description: Blade of the Demon King. Don't let the gluttony consumes you.

hourglass_archiver.name: Hourglass of the Archiver
hourglass_archiver.description: Magic is, in a way, science.

spear_red_dragon.name: Spear of the Red Dragon
spear_red_dragon.description: You are destined to die. Why not make it interesting?

dagger_and_pike.name: Dagger and Pike
dagger_and_pike.description: Whispers in the wind... or is it?

banshees_call.name: Banshee's Call
banshees_call.description: The scream of the dead guides your blade.

leather_cap.name: Leather Cap
leather_cap.description: Hardened hide. Keeps your skull in one piece.

iron_helm.name: Iron Helm
iron_helm.description: Heavy iron. Turns aside what leather can't.

mage_hood.name: Mage Hood
mage_hood.description: Rune-stitched. Sharpens what your eyes can't see.

dragon_helm.name: Dragon Helm
dragon_helm.description: Dragonbone skull. Wear the predator's face.

crown_of_madness.name: Crown of Madness
crown_of_madness.description: Madness is a gift. Unwrap it.

copper_ring.name: Copper Ring
copper_ring.description: Faded symbols. Faint luck. Better than nothing.

ring_of_vitality.name: Ring of Vitality
ring_of_vitality.description: Bloodstone heart. Pulses with stolen warmth.

signet_of_war.name: Signet of War
signet_of_war.description: A general's seal. Every strike hits harder.

ring_of_the_void.name: Ring of the Void
ring_of_the_void.description: Stare into the void. It stares back. And flinches.
